tools.name: get_editor_snapshot
tools.description: Read one platform of the open editor. Pass platform or platformSetId to include that set's screenshots. With no argument, a project with one platform set returns that set. A project with more than one set returns the set directory and screenshotsOmitted, without screenshot bodies. Call again with pl

tools.name: update_text
tools.description: Update a text layer on a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add a text layer to a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: remove_text
tools.description: Remove a text layer from a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: add_screenshot
tools.description: Add a card to the end of a platform set. The card is not blank: the set's first three cards get the template's sample texts and phone placement (sometimes a hidden or tilted phone), and later cards copy every layer of the set's last card without its phone image. Returns the ids of those layers so yo

tools.name: update_screenshot
tools.description: Update a card and its main phone: background, phone placement and app screen, pattern, fade, or shadow. imageUrl is the app screen inside the phone (upload_image with type screenshot). The phone model is chosen per platform set with set_device.

tools.name: remove_screenshot
tools.description: Remove a screenshot from the open editor.

tools.name: add_asset
tools.description: Add an image layer to a card. src is an image URL, such as one from upload_image or list_library. Pass spriteCoordinate to crop one pose of a sprite sheet.

tools.name: update_asset
tools.description: Update an image layer on a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: remove_asset
tools.description: Remove an image layer from a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: add_div
tools.description: Add a box layer to a card. Pass html to draw a custom card: width and height set its layout box, and every visible style goes in the html, since backgroundColor and borderRadius only style plain boxes without html. A style element stays inside the card.

tools.name: update_div
tools.description: Update a box layer on a card.

tools.name: remove_div
tools.description: Remove a box layer from a screenshot in the open editor.

tools.name: add_phone
tools.description: Add another phone to a screenshot card in the open editor. It uses the platform set's device frame and starts next to the main phone with its size, rotation, and shadow. Set imageUrl to an image URL (upload_image with type screenshot). Extra phones paint above the main phone, in the order they were

tools.name: update_phone
tools.description: Update an extra phone added with add_phone. Takes the same phone fields as update_screenshot. The main phone is edited with update_screenshot.

tools.name: remove_phone
tools.description: Remove an extra phone added with add_phone.

tools.name: reorder_element
tools.description: Move a layer one step forward or backward among layers of the same kind. It cannot move a layer across kinds: back to front, cards always paint back divs, phones, image layers, front divs, then texts.

tools.name: set_template
tools.description: Set the template of the open project.

tools.name: update_template_color
tools.description: Update one color of the open project's template. colorId must be one of the current template's colors: minimal (bg), gradient (from, via, to), geometric (bg, circle1, circle2), wave (from, to, wave), glass (from, to), connected (bg, dots). value is a CSS color such as #22c55e.

tools.name: set_resolution
tools.description: Set the pixel size of a platform set.

tools.name: set_device
tools.description: Set the device of a platform set. iOS sets take iphone-13-pro, iphone-13-pro-max, iphone-15-pro, iphone-15-pro-max, iphone-17-pro, iphone-17-pro-max, iphone-18-pro, iphone-18-pro-max, iphone-duo, borderless-frame, ipad-pro-12, ipad-pro-13, macbook-air-13, macbook-air-15, macbook-pro-14, macbook-pro-

tools.name: set_phone_color
tools.description: Set the device color of a platform set. On a HyperRealistic (threeDFrame) set the device shows only its real finishes: pass one of the set's deviceColors ids (see the snapshot); a generic color (black, white, orange, silver, space-gray, blue, purple, red, green) picks the closest real finish.

tools.name: set_show_notch
tools.description: Show or hide the notch on a platform set.

tools.name: set_squircle_frame
tools.description: Enable or disable the squircle frame on a platform set.

tools.name: set_link_texts
tools.description: Link or unlink matching text layers across platform sets.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Rename the open project.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit in the open editor.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone edit in the open editor.

tools.name: search_google_fonts
tools.description: Search Google Fonts by family name, category, or both. usable is true when the project can already use the family: a built-in editor font or one added with add_project_font.

tools.name: add_project_font
tools.description: Add a Google Fonts family to the open project. Then use it as fontFamily on text layers or as font-family in card html. Built-in editor fonts need no adding.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: List assets or mascots saved on this account (not screenshots or backgrounds). Items with spriteSheet true have poses, crop rectangles for add_asset spriteCoordinate. Also returns one image of up to 10 items with each id beside its picture.

tools.name: get_sprite
tools.description: Return one saved asset or mascot in the same shape as a list_library item, including spriteSheet and poses. Also returns one image of each pose with its index drawn beside it.

tools.name: generate_asset
tools.description: Generate an asset sprite with AI and save it to the account library. Spends credits. Returns imageUrl and poses like get_sprite, with a preview of each pose. Does not place it on a card.

tools.name: generate_mascot
tools.description: Generate a mascot sprite with AI and save it to the account library. Spends credits. Returns imageUrl and poses like get_sprite, with a preview of each pose. Does not place it on a card.

tools.name: generate_background
tools.description: Generate an AI background for one card. Spends credits.

tools.name: update_store_listing
tools.description: Update App Store or Google Play listing fields for the current language. Does not generate copy. Returns the names of the fields written.

tools.name: capture_platform_strip
tools.description: Return one JPEG of every card in a platform set side by side, as the editor renders them. Use it to check your edits. Defaults to the first platform set.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Prepare an image upload for the open project. Returns a one-time uploadUrl. POST the image as multipart form field "file" to that URL. The response JSON url is the stored image. Use it with update_screenshot imageUrl, add_asset src, set_project_background, or img src and CSS url() inside add_div or

tools.name: duplicate_screenshot
tools.description: Duplicate a screenshot and insert the copy immediately after it.

tools.name: copy_screenshot
tools.description: Copy a screenshot onto another platform set.

tools.name: move_screenshot
tools.description: Move a screenshot left or right within its platform set.

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Switch the open editor to a language that already exists on the project.

tools.name: ai_translate
tools.description: Add up to 5 languages by translating the open language with the same AI localize flow as the editor. Translates iOS and Android screenshot text and the store listing. Social screenshot text is copied unchanged. Spends credits. Does not switch the open language. Fails when the account cannot spend cr

tools.name: add_platform_set
tools.description: Add a platform set to the open project.

tools.name: remove_platform_set
tools.description: Remove an extra platform set. The first set of each platform stays.

tools.name: set_project_background
tools.description: Set or clear the project background image. Pass an empty imageUrl to clear it.

tools.name: set_realistic_frame
tools.description: Enable or disable the realistic device frame on a platform set. With threeD true the frame is a 3D device model (HyperRealistic) that also takes rotationX, rotationY, and rotationZ. 3D works on every device except borderless-frame and android-borderless-frame.

tools.name: report_mcp_feedback
tools.description: Report a bug, an unexpected tool result, or a suggestion about these MCP tools, when you notice one.

tools.name: rate_this_mcp
tools.description: Rate how well these MCP tools worked for the task you just finished, from 1 to 5 stars. Call it once per task.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "set_device" is 751 chars, far longer than this server's median (78). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_phone, add_project_font, upload_image · Private data: upload_image · Public sink: reorder_element, upload_image · Destructive: remove_text, add_screenshot, remove_screenshot, remove_asset, remove_div, remove_phone, remove_platform_set.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_phone, add_project_font, upload_image · Private data: upload_image · Public sink: reorder_element, upload_image · Destructive: remove_text, add_screenshot, remove_screenshot, remove_asset, remove_div, remove_phone, remove_platform_set

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
